text:
tara_sales: Heads-up: HorizonTel wants an assurance packet for the POC. They asked for SOC2 excerpt (control summary), ISO scope, subprocessors list, a short KMS/encryption attestation, and a 'pen-test letter' phrase was used. They also want a Hosted vs Dedicated network sketch and delta on Dedicated pricing with single-tenant burst. Need something by EOD Tues.

mike_se: Are they starting on hosted sandbox? Network sketch depends on that. Also who is their security lead?

tara_sales: Starting hosted sandbox. Security lead is emma@horizontel.com.

olivia_sec: We can produce SOC2 excerpt and ISO scope in 2 business days and share the subprocessors CSV with redactions. We cannot issue a third-party pen-test letter unless Legal arranges and signs off (and assessor is involved). For POC, options: 1) our internal attestation (fast), 2) customer-run scanner with ephemeral creds (fastest), 3) formal assessor letter (requires PO and ~7-10 business days).

ben_infra: For scanner: we offer presigned S3 objects or short-lived STS assume-role. Example presign CLI: aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc/horizon-scan.tar.gz --expires-in 3600. Need IP ranges and preferred window.

leo_legal: I can sign our standard attestation immediately. If they insist on naming an assessor, send PO + scope and we'll coordinate; timeline per Olivia.

tara_sales: I'll ask Emma whether they accept our attestation or plan to run their own scan. Also requesting IP ranges and burst targets for pricing calc. Will update here. Thanks!
